parameters.name: ReportDate
parameters.description: The report date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, that the report was sent to the collector.

parameters.name: AgentIdentifier
parameters.description: Identifier of the measurement agent at the time the measurement was run.

parameters.name: GroupIdentifier
parameters.description: Identifier of the measurement group of interest to which the MA belongs.

parameters.name: MeasurementPoint
parameters.description: Identifier of the measurement point indicating where the measurement agent is located on a path as defined in {{bibref|RFC7398}}.

object.description: This {{object}} object instance represents a report that is generated by a reporting task where the reporting task is defined as a {{object|#.MeasurementAgent.{i}.Task.{i}}} and executed as a scheduled action ({{object|#.MeasurementAgent.{i}.Schedule.{i}.Action.{i}}}). The {{object}} replicates the {{object|#.MeasurementAgent.{i}}} object instance's data at the time of the action execution. When a {{object|##.BulkData.Profile.{i}}} object instance is used to communicate a {{object}} instance, the CPE adds a {{object|##.BulkData.Profile.{i}.Parameter.{i}}} object instance referring to this {{object}} object instance.
